scripts.check: biome check package.json scripts && bun run --workspaces --if-present --sequential check
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json scripts && bun run --workspaces --if-present --sequential format
scripts.format:check: biome format package.json scripts && bun run --workspaces --if-present --sequential format:check
scripts.lint: biome lint scripts && bun run --workspaces --if-present --sequential lint
scripts.prepare: if command -v husky >/dev/null 2>&1; then husky; fi
